heading: Postgraduate Research Opportunities (Ph.D. & Master's by Research)
subheading: Join Dr. Zaid Amin's Research Initiative in Human-Centered AI, Digital Ethics, and Attention Systems at INTI International University
statement: I am actively seeking highly motivated, intellectually curious postgraduate scholars (Ph.D. candidates and Master's by Research students) who wish to solve profound problems at the intersection of Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), AI Governance, Cognitive Attention Systems, and Digital Society. If you want your research to move beyond incremental benchmarking and directly impact human well-being and technological policy, our group provides an intellectually rigorous and supportive home.

what_we_offer.title: Rigorous International Publication Track
what_we_offer.description: Direct, hands-on mentorship aimed at publishing in top-tier conferences and journals (e.g., ACM CHI, CSCW, IEEE Access, Springer LNCS, MDPI).

what_we_offer.title: Interdisciplinary Synthesis
what_we_offer.description: A unique research bridge connecting deep computer science and data analytics with behavioral psychology, ethics, and cybernetics.

what_we_offer.title: Career Acceleration
what_we_offer.description: Graduates from our programs are prepared for high-impact careers in academic professorships, industrial AI research labs, and policy institutes.

what_we_offer.title: Collaborative Network
what_we_offer.description: Active research linkages across Malaysian top universities (UKM, etc.), regional Southeast Asian institutions, and international collaborators.

open_topics.title: Agentic AI Safety & The Proxy Trap
open_topics.skills_required: Python, LLM frameworks, Reinforcement Learning, Alignment concepts, or formal evaluation methods.
open_topics.description: Investigating how multi-agent systems diverge from human goals when optimizing surrogate rewards, and constructing verified audit mechanisms for automated civic and enterprise decision-making.

open_topics.title: Attention-Based Interface Interventions & Digital Well-Being
open_topics.skills_required: HCI methods, Frontend/Fullstack prototyping, Eye-tracking/Behavioral analytics, Quantitative user study design.
open_topics.description: Extending the Tune-Attention model to design cognitive micro-frictions and intentional friction systems that reduce information overload, dark pattern susceptibility, and misinformation dissemination.

open_topics.title: Multimodal AI Orchestration for Sustainable Urban Governance
open_topics.skills_required: Data Science, Computer Vision, Geospatial analytics, Agent frameworks.
open_topics.description: Developing verifiable, edge-deployable multi-agent systems for municipal compliance, environmental reporting, and civic citizen-in-the-loop engagement.

open_topics.title: Immersive Virtual Heritage & Spatial Social Computing
open_topics.skills_required: Unity / Unreal Engine, WebXR, 3D modeling, Cultural informatics.
open_topics.description: Pioneering interactive virtual heritage platforms (extending the Srivijayapedia initiative) using immersive VR to reconstruct lost civilizational records and explore collective memory.

prerequisites: A strong academic background in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or related interdisciplinary fields.
Demonstrated programming capability (Python, modern web/XR frameworks, or statistical packages like R/SPSS).
Solid English writing and scientific literature review competence.
application_steps: 1. Review my recent publications (e.g., IEEE Access 2021, Smart Cities 2026, SSRN 2026) to ensure our research interests genuinely align.
2. Prepare a 1-page Research Statement explaining the specific problem you want to tackle and how it connects to our research group.

3. Send your CV (including academic transcripts, publication list, and GitHub/portfolio link) with the subject: '[Prospective Postgraduate] - [Your Full Name] - [Ph.D./Master]' to zaid.amin@newinti.edu.my.
